effects.name: Apparition
effects.description: Twists into a ghostly swirl and fades away

effects.name: Aura Glow
effects.description: A glowing aura eats the window from its edges in

effects.name: Broken Glass
effects.description: Cracks into shards that fly out and fall

effects.name: Doom
effects.description: The screen melt from Doom, column by column

effects.name: Energize A
effects.description: The original transporter: a cloud of sparkles

effects.name: Energize B
effects.description: The later transporter: rising streaks of gold

effects.name: Fire
effects.description: Burns from the bottom up behind a front of flames

effects.name: Focus
effects.description: Blurs out of focus and fades

effects.name: Glide
effects.description: Tilts away from you, shrinks and fades

effects.name: Glitch
effects.description: Jumps, splits its colours and drops out in blocks

effects.name: Hexagon
effects.description: Winks out as a honeycomb with glowing seams

effects.name: Incinerate
effects.description: A spark burns a hole that spreads outwards

effects.name: Magic Lamp
effects.description: Pulled down into the bottom edge like a genie

effects.name: Matrix
effects.description: Digital rain eats the window column by column

effects.name: Mushroom
effects.description: An 8-bit power-down with a starburst

effects.name: Paint Brush
effects.description: Broad brush strokes wipe it away, row by row

effects.name: Pixelate
effects.description: Coarsens into big pixels that drop out

effects.name: Pixel Wheel
effects.description: Becomes a wheel of blocks that spins away

effects.name: Pixel Wipe
effects.description: A wave of pixels sweeps out from the pointer

effects.name: Portal
effects.description: A swirling portal opens, sucks it in and closes

effects.name: RGB Warp
effects.description: The colour channels drift apart in waves

effects.name: Snap of Disintegration
effects.description: Crumbles into dust that blows away

effects.name: Team Rocket
effects.description: Blasted off over the horizon with a twinkle

effects.name: T-Rex Attack
effects.description: Claw marks rip across it and the strips fall

effects.name: TV Effect
effects.description: An old CRT switching off

effects.name: TV Glitch
effects.description: The CRT switch-off with a bad signal

effects.name: Wisps
effects.description: Fades while glowing wisps float off it

effects.name: ASCII
effects.description: Turns into coloured text that flickers out

effects.name: Warp Speed
effects.description: Stretches into streaks of light and jumps away

effects.name: Dwindle
effects.description: Splits into Hyprland's dwindle tiles, gapped and bordered, that close one by one

effects.name: Boot Log
effects.description: Line by line it becomes a scrolling boot log, [  OK  ] and all

effects.name: Theme Swap
effects.description: A band recolours it like a new Omarchy theme, and it comes apart in stripes

effects.name: Plymouth
effects.description: Squeezes into the boot splash's progress bar, which fills and fades

effects.name: Border Trace
effects.description: Comets in the active border's gradient chase round it as it draws in

effects.name: Summit
effects.description: Breaks into triangles that wink out until only a peak is left
